sources.title: GitHub - NikkieHooman/clinical-lora
sources.snippet: Large language models are powerful but general. This repo shows how to specialize Llama-3-8B for clinical text using parameter-efficient fine-tuning, specifically QLoRA, by adding only around 0.5% trainable parameters on top of the frozen base model.
